post.description:
Create or update a user with a password hashed using the per-organization salt (v2).
Generates missing tenant orgSalt automatically. Sets user.hashVersion = 2.
This is a minimal demo endpoint; add email verification and stricter validations for production.

1.v2 (current): tenant.orgSalt (+ optional global pepper from env) concatenated with password, hashed using argon2id when available, then bcrypt, then scrypt as a fallback. New accounts use v2.

Inline notes on hashing scheme and migra.2: If tenant.orgSalt is missing (legacy tenants), it is auto-generated and persisted on-demand.

post.description: Authenticate a user by organization, email and password. Performs on-login migration from legacy hash to per-tenant orgSalt scheme.

Resets a user's password using the v2 scheme (tenant orgSalt + optional global pepper).
Auto-generates tenant orgSalt if missing (legacy tenant). DEMO ONLY – add token validation and throttling for production.

SECURITY & MIGRATION NOTES.0: This endpoint rehashes using v2 regardless of prior version; user.hashVersion is set to 2 on success.
SECURITY & MIGRATION NOTES.1: If tenant.orgSalt is missing, it is generated and persisted before hashing.

get.description:
Returns a tabular-friendly list of LLM cost documents. Always returns an envelope { success, data, meta } with pagination. Indexed filters and projections are applied to avoid timeouts. Time filtering is applied ONLY on the canonical field 'timestamp'.
Tenant scoping: When Authorization (Bearer JWT) is present, the tenant from the JWT is enforced and overrides any header/query values. If a different organization_id/tenant_id is provided than the JWT tenant, the request is rejected with 403. Without JWT (demo/testing), x-organization-id header or query aliases (?tenant_id or ?organization_id) may be used to set scope. Any tenant fields in the filter are ignored server-side.
Debugging: Responses include headers indicating effective tenant, filter, projection, sort and timing.

parameters.name: x-organization-id
parameters.description: Tenant (organization) ID. Required when JWT is not provided; ignored if JWT is present with tenant. If provided and conflicts with JWT tenant, the request is rejected with 403.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: Alias for tenant filter. Ignored when JWT is present. Header takes precedence over query. If conflicting with JWT tenant, 403 is returned.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Alias for tenant filter. Ignored when JWT is present. Header takes precedence over query. If conflicting with JWT tenant, 403 is returned.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default DEFAULT_PAGE_LIMIT, max 200). If omitted or invalid, DEFAULT_PAGE_LIMIT is applied. Requests with limit > 200 return 400.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort string (e.g., -timestamp or total_cost)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO date-time lower bound (applied to timestamp only). If from and to are both omitted, the server applies a default window of MAX_DAYS_WINDOW (default 90 days) ending at now. If only one bound is provided, the other bound is clamped such that the window does not exceed MAX_DAYS_WINDOW. If both provided and the window exceeds MAX_DAYS_WINDOW, the server returns 400.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO date-time upper bound (applied to timestamp only). If from and to are both omitted, the server applies a default window of MAX_DAYS_WINDOW (default 90 days) ending at now. If only one bound is provided, the other bound is clamped such that the window does not exceed MAX_DAYS_WINDOW. If both provided and the window exceeds MAX_DAYS_WINDOW, the server returns 400.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON filter (tenant fields ignored by server; scoping enforced). Whitelist: status, provider, llm_model, user_id, session_id, project_id, request_id

x-llm-explain-find.description: Present when DEBUG_LLMCOSTS_EXPLAIN=1 and find explain captured

x-llm-explain-count.description: Present when DEBUG_LLMCOSTS_EXPLAIN=1 and count explain captured

x-llm-timing-explain-ms.description: Explain capture time in ms (when enabled)

x-llm-window-applied.description: default|clamped_to|clamped_from when the server applied defaults/clamps

details.description: Optional details containing raw breakdown, metadata and any extra fields

raw.description: Any remaining top-level fields not part of standard columns

400.description: Bad request: Missing tenant, invalid filter JSON, limit > 200 (max enforced), or date window exceeds MAX_DAYS_WINDOW. When default/clamped windows are applied, headers x-llm-window-*: inform the effective window.

403.description: Forbidden: tenant scope mismatch when Authorization is provided
